acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Wayfinder decision establishes multi-dimensional deterministic readiness contract with per-advisory-class evaluation
Machine-readable schema kad-promotion-readiness-v1 and policy contract define unambiguous states (INSUFFICIENT_DATA, INVALID_EVIDENCE, POLICY_DRIFT, READY_FOR_CANARY_DESIGN)
Readiness evaluation is strictly fail-closed on hash-chain corruption, sequence gaps, historical tampering, and policy/evaluator fingerprint drift
Per-advisory-class evaluation assesses opportunity class occurrences, divergence counts, and UNKNOWN rates independently
Strict epistemic separation enforced: READY_FOR_CANARY_DESIGN means only readiness to design an intervention, never promotion authorization or empirical savings claim
Synthetic test fixtures are unmistakably labeled and cannot masquerade as live evidence
Operator interface surfaces readiness via bin/kad observatory readiness and bin/kad observatory readiness --json without noisy compact status degradation
All 22 required TDD test cases (T1-T22) pass and all 510 regression tests remain green with zero routing mutations
